title: OKF Bundle Manifest v1.0
description: Official JSON Schema for Open Knowledge Format (OKF) bundles used by Helix. Designed for cross-machine knowledge sharing, especially file change tracking and auto-generated Mermaid diagrams.

description.description: Optional description of what this bundle provides

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the manifest was generated

tools.description: List of tool definitions provided by this bundle

knowledge.description: List of knowledge documents. Supports Mermaid diagrams, file snapshots, directory trees, and change logs for cross-machine project mapping.

schemas.description: JSON Schema definitions exported by the bundle

metadata.description: Bundle-level metadata. Recommended for multi-machine setups.

source_machine.description: Name or ID of the machine that generated this bundle (e.g. 'desktop-pc', 'laptop', 'proxmox-dell630')

description.description: Human-readable description of what the tool does

input_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the expected input parameters

output_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the expected output

implementation.description: Hint for how the tool is implemented (e.g. 'rust', 'python', 'remote-http', 'wasm')

id.description: Unique identifier for the knowledge item (e.g. 'project-structure-2025-04-05', 'file-changes-desktop')

content_type.description: MIME or format type. Special support for diagrams and file tracking.

content.description: Inline content. For Mermaid: put the full ```mermaid ... ``` block here.

url.description: URL to fetch full content (if not inline). Useful when OKF server hosts large diagrams.

metadata.description: Per-knowledge metadata. Critical for cross-machine file change tracking.

detected_at.description: ISO timestamp of file change or scan

title.description: Optional human title for the schema
